title: Native UI Blocking Calls
description: Browser-native prompt/alert/confirm discouraged in SPA/Electron — use inline modal/toast. Enable via project.invariants.yaml → frontend.forbidden_ui_calls.

rules.message: Native prompt() blocks renderer and breaks UX/i18n patterns.
rules.remediation: Use a modal/dialog component with controlled input state.

rules.message: Native alert() blocks UI thread — use toast/inline notice.
rules.remediation: Use project toast/notification component or inline flash banner.

rules.message: Native confirm() blocks UI — use explicit confirm modal.
